design_philosophy.core_principle: Safety First: Green means Go, Red means Stop. Clarity over decoration.

headings.usage: All page titles, card headers, and modal titles. Use uppercase for small labels.

data.usage: IDs, QR Codes, Stock Numbers, Dates, IP Addresses.

gradients.usage: Minimal. Only for 'Active' states or subtle highlights.

glassmorphism.usage: Use sparingly for sticky headers or overlays.

buttons.primary: bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-white font-medium shadow-sm rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-all
buttons.danger: bg-red-500 hover:bg-red-600 text-white font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-all

cards.default: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-md shadow-sm p-6
cards.interactive: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-md shadow-sm p-6 hover:border-emerald-300 hover:shadow-md transition-all cursor-pointer

inputs.default: flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 focus:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

badges.success: bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium
badges.warning: bg-orange-100 text-orange-700 border border-orange-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium
badges.error: bg-red-100 text-red-700 border border-red-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium
badges.neutral: bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium

login_hero.description: Worker in high-vis vest, professional and safe. Use for Login/Signup split screen.

dashboard_banner.description: Modern factory interior. Use for dashboard welcome header background (with overlay).

inventory_hero.description: Safety equipment (helmet, gloves). Use for EPI/Inventory section headers.

team_placeholder.description: Worker in hard hat. Use as default avatar or team section hero.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px or 2px. Consistent size (w-4 h-4 for buttons, w-5 h-5 for nav).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Manrope' for all Headings and 'Inter' for body text. Import them in index.css.
Implement a 'Sidebar' layout for the main dashboard. The sidebar should be dark (Slate 900) with Emerald accents.
Use the 'Emerald' color scale for all primary actions. Do not use blue.
For the 'EPI Delivery' screen, prioritize large buttons and clear facial recognition camera view.
Ensure all data tables (Stock, Users) use 'JetBrains Mono' for ID columns.
Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors or subtle patterns.
All interactive elements must have 'data-testid' attributes.
Use 'recharts' for any analytics charts (Stock levels, Days without accident).
The 'Days without Accident' counter should be a prominent 'Big Number' card on the dashboard.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) sparingly (only for overlays)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
